name: Flash sale inventory reservation / Define the success contract

intent.outcome: Design an e-commerce checkout system handling high-concurrency item reservation without double-selling.
intent.users: Callers, state owners and operators named by the problem.
intent.constraints: Make ordering, durability, capacity and retry assumptions explicit. One synthetic stock authority; no real payments, distributed transaction consensus or multi-region locking.
intent.success: An observable request path, bounded waiting, visible failures and a justified recovery policy.

concepts.label: Users and requests
concepts.responsibility: Who issues requests, and which identities or deadlines travel with them?

concepts.label: System responsibility
concepts.responsibility: Design an e-commerce checkout system handling high-concurrency item reservation without double-selling.
